contract: Every case resets the full seed. These are read-only gate fixtures: allowed means eligible for hypothetical queue admission only, not a placed call, legal clearance, confirmed appointment or treatment. No state changes. reasons includes every failing gate sorted alphabetically. Event deduplication must precede any future enqueue. Gate start times use Asia/Kolkata. An inbound callback is not explicit ongoing voice consent.
required_information: Eligibility is not proof of the recipient's identity; any future conversation must verify identity before discussing stored enquiry details or writing records.
Only administrative follow-up is in scope; insurance uncertainty, clinical questions and disputed cancellation/refund eligibility require human escalation with authorized context.
A future verified opt-out must stop follow-up immediately; failed tools must never be reported as completed actions.
prohibited_actions: Dial, enqueue or call any real target
Reveal stored information to an unverified recipient
Bypass opt-out or grant consent from a website submission
Promise clinical outcomes, coverage, price, refund approval or attendance
